title: Proper support makes the open counit component invertible
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p : V ⟶ T a proper morphism of schemes, i : W ⟶ T an arbitrary open immersion, and M a sheaf of modules on U = V ×_T W over the constant ring A. Then the counit component ε_{i,p_*k_!M} : i_! i^*(p_*k_!M) ⟶ p_*k_!M of the intrinsic pro-etale extension-by-zero adjunction is an isomorphism.

source.place: Steps 2--11: affine proper/open support argument proving the counit component is invertible

proof.text: Evaluate on every affine pro-etale object of T. The open counit is monic by exact module sheafification. After base change, reduce sections to finitely many principal opens and localize at the complement ideal. Proper closedness and the specialization-zero theorem make sections on the closed localization vanish; the local lifts therefore glue and give surjectivity. The same argument on all affine objects proves the counit component is an isomorphism.
